list.name: group
list.label: Global Collection
list.query: SELECT gc_name AS __text, gc_rec_ID AS __value FROM reporting.globalcollection ORDER BY gc_name
list.definition: SELECT gc_name AS __text, gc_rec_ID AS __value FROM reporting.globalcollection ORDER BY gc_name

list.name: deviceType
list.label: Device Type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT device_type FROM reporting.devicemodel WHERE device_type IS NOT NULL AND destroy_time IS NULL ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT device_type FROM reporting.devicemodel WHERE device_type IS NOT NULL AND destroy_time IS NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: devices
list.label: Devices
list.query: SELECT e.entity_name AS __text, e.current_model_key AS __value FROM reporting.entity e JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=e.current_model_key WHERE dm.destroy_time IS NULL AND (-1 IN ($group) OR e.current_model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT e.entity_name AS __text, e.current_model_key AS __value FROM reporting.entity e JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=e.current_model_key WHERE dm.destroy_time IS NULL AND (-1 IN ($group) OR e.current_model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM reporting.modeloutage mo JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=mo.model_key WHERE dm.device_type IN (${deviceType:singlequote}) AND (-1 IN ($group) OR mo.model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) AND (-1 IN ($devices) OR mo.model_key IN ($devices)) AND $__timeFilter(mo.start_time)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS unplanned FROM reporting.modeloutage mo JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=mo.model_key WHERE mo.outage_type=1 AND dm.device_type IN (${deviceType:singlequote}) AND (-1 IN ($group) OR mo.model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) AND (-1 IN ($devices) OR mo.model_key IN ($devices)) AND $__timeFilter(mo.start_time)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS planned FROM reporting.modeloutage mo JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=mo.model_key WHERE mo.outage_type=2 AND dm.device_type IN (${deviceType:singlequote}) AND (-1 IN ($group) OR mo.model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) AND (-1 IN ($devices) OR mo.model_key IN ($devices)) AND $__timeFilter(mo.start_time)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS exempt FROM reporting.modeloutage mo JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=mo.model_key WHERE mo.outage_type=3 AND dm.device_type IN (${deviceType:singlequote}) AND (-1 IN ($group) OR mo.model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) AND (-1 IN ($devices) OR mo.model_key IN ($devices)) AND $__timeFilter(mo.start_time)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mo.model_key) AS devices FROM reporting.modeloutage mo JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=mo.model_key WHERE dm.device_type IN (${deviceType:singlequote}) AND (-1 IN ($group) OR mo.model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) AND (-1 IN ($devices) OR mo.model_key IN ($devices)) AND $__timeFilter(mo.start_time)

SELECT v.vendor_name AS `Vendor`, v.vendor AS `Vendor ID`, mc.mclass_name AS `Class`, dm.device_type AS `Device Type`, e.entity_name AS `Name`, dm.location AS `Location`, ot.outage_desc AS `Outage Type`, mo.start_time AS `Outage Start Time`, COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(mo.end_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),'ongoing') AS `Outage End Time`, CONCAT(FLOOR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,mo.start_time,COALESCE(mo.end_time,NOW()))/86400),' Days ',LPAD(FLOOR(MOD(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,mo.start_time,COALESCE(mo.end_time,NOW())),86400)/3600),2,'0'),':',LPAD(FLOOR(MOD(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,mo.start_time,COALESCE(mo.end_time,NOW())),3600)/60),2,'0'),':',LPAD(MOD(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,mo.start_time,COALESCE(mo.end_time,NOW())),60),2,'0')) AS `Outage Duration`, n.notes AS `Outage Note` FROM reporting.modeloutage mo JOIN reporting.entity e ON e.current_model_key=mo.model_key JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=mo.model_key JOIN reporting.vendor v ON v.vendor=dm.vendor JOIN reporting.modelclass mc ON mc.model_class=dm.model_class JOIN reporting.outagetype ot ON ot.outage_type=mo.outage_type LEFT JOIN reporting.modeloutage_notes n ON n.model_outage_ID=mo.model_outage_ID WHERE mo.outage_type IN ($outageType) AND dm.device_type IN (${deviceType:singlequote}) AND (-1 IN ($group) OR mo.model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) AND (-1 IN ($devices) OR mo.model_key IN ($devices)) AND $__timeFilter(mo.start_time) ORDER BY mo.start_time DESC LIMIT 500
